info.title: PolicyEngine Simulation Gateway API
info.description: Submit and poll simulation jobs on Modal

post.description:
Submit a simulation job.

Routes to the appropriate simulation app based on country and version.
Returns immediately with a job_id for polling.

Submit a budget-window batch job.

Returns immediately with a parent batch job ID for polling.

get.description:
Poll for job status.

Returns:
    - 200 with status="complete" and result when done
    - 202 with status="running" while in progress
    - 404 if job_id not found
    - 500 with status="failed" and error on failure
Get available versions for policyengine, US, or UK routing.

post.description: Verify the API is able to receive and process requests.

AgePovertyOutput.title: AgePovertyOutput
AgePovertyOutput.description: Baseline and reform poverty rates for children, adults, seniors and everyone.

BaselineReformValue.title: BaselineReformValue
BaselineReformValue.description: A metric's value under the baseline and under the reform.

BudgetWindowBatchRequest.title: BudgetWindowBatchRequest
BudgetWindowBatchRequest.description: Request model for budget-window batch submission.

BudgetWindowBatchStatusResponse.title: BudgetWindowBatchStatusResponse
BudgetWindowBatchStatusResponse.description: Response model for budget-window batch polling.

BudgetWindowBatchSubmitResponse.title: BudgetWindowBatchSubmitResponse
BudgetWindowBatchSubmitResponse.description: Response model for budget-window batch submission.

BudgetWindowTotals.title: BudgetWindowTotals
BudgetWindowTotals.description: Aggregate totals for a completed budget-window response.

BudgetaryImpact.title: BudgetaryImpact
BudgetaryImpact.description:
Headline budget effect of the reform for the simulated year.

Impacts are reform minus baseline totals in the country's currency.
``budgetary_impact`` is ``tax_revenue_impact`` minus
``benefit_spending_impact``; ``state_tax_revenue_impact`` covers US state
income tax and is 0 for the UK. ``households`` is the weighted number of
households and ``baseline_net_income`` their total baseline net income.

CliffImpactInSimulation.title: CliffImpactInSimulation
CliffImpactInSimulation.description:
Exposure to tax-benefit cliffs in one simulation.

``cliff_gap`` is the total net income people would lose from a small rise in
their earnings, and ``cliff_share`` the share of adults on a cliff.

CliffImpactOutput.title: CliffImpactOutput
CliffImpactOutput.description: Exposure to tax-benefit cliffs under the baseline and under the reform.

CongressionalDistrictImpactOutput.title: CongressionalDistrictImpactOutput
CongressionalDistrictImpactOutput.description: Reform impact for each US congressional district in the simulated region.

CongressionalDistrictImpactRecord.title: CongressionalDistrictImpactRecord
CongressionalDistrictImpactRecord.description:
Reform impact on household net income in one US congressional district.

``district`` is the state abbreviation and two-digit district number, such
as ``"CA-12"``; at-large districts are numbered ``01``. The income changes
are the average change per household and the relative change in the
district's total household net income. The three percentage fields are the
shares of people whose household net income rises, falls, or stays
essentially unchanged.

ConstituencyImpactRecord.title: ConstituencyImpactRecord
ConstituencyImpactRecord.description:
Reform impact on household net income in one UK parliamentary constituency.

``average_household_income_change`` is the average change per household and
``relative_household_income_change`` the relative change in the area's total
household net income, both rounded to the order of their standard error.
``population`` is the weighted number of households. ``x`` and ``y`` are
integer map-rendering coordinates.

DecileOutput.title: DecileOutput
DecileOutput.description:
Change in average household net income in each decile.

Keys are decile numbers from ``"1"`` (lowest) to ``"10"`` (highest); the same
shape is used for income deciles and UK wealth deciles. ``average`` is the
absolute change and ``relative`` the change relative to the decile's
baseline average.

DetailedBudgetOutput.title: DetailedBudgetOutput
DetailedBudgetOutput.description: Program name mapped to its baseline and reform totals.

DetailedBudgetProgramOutput.title: DetailedBudgetProgramOutput
DetailedBudgetProgramOutput.description:
Baseline and reform totals for one program.

``difference`` is reform minus baseline.

GenderPovertyOutput.title: GenderPovertyOutput
GenderPovertyOutput.description: Baseline and reform poverty rates for males and females.

GeographicImpactOutput.title: GeographicImpactOutput
GeographicImpactOutput.description:
UK constituency or local-authority impact records.

Areas whose income change disclosure control withholds are left out.

InequalityOutput.title: InequalityOutput
InequalityOutput.description:
Baseline and reform income inequality.

Covers the Gini coefficient and the income shares of the top 10% and top 1%.

IntraDecileOutput.title: IntraDecileOutput
IntraDecileOutput.description:
Share of people in each decile who gain or lose, grouped by size of change.

The categories are gaining or losing more or less than 5% of household net
income, or no change. ``deciles`` lists each category's share for deciles 1
to 10 in order, and ``all`` gives each category's average across the deciles.

JobSegmentProgress.title: JobSegmentProgress
JobSegmentProgress.description: Completed region segments of a segmented national run.

JobStage.title: JobStage
JobStage.description:
Coarse stages of an annual economy job, in the order they run.

A monolithic run moves through ``loading_data``, ``baseline``, ``reform``
and ``outputs``. A segmented US national run computes baseline and reform
together in parallel region segments, so it moves through
``loading_data``, ``simulating`` and ``outputs``.

Later versions may add stages. Clients must accept a value they do not
know, for example by showing a generic "running" state.

stage.description: Current stage of a running job, or the stage in which a failed job stopped. Absent for complete jobs. Later versions may add stages; clients must accept a value they do not know.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Coarse completion percent at the start of the current stage. It changes only at stage boundaries, stays below 100 while running, and is 100 when complete.

progress_max.title: Progress Max
progress_max.description: Highest percent a running job reaches before its next stage starts. A client can move a time-based estimate between progress and progress_max.

submitted_at.title: Submitted At
submitted_at.description: When the gateway accepted the job.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When a worker started the job.

finished_at.title: Finished At
finished_at.description: When the worker finished or stopped the job.

segments.description: Region segments of a segmented US national run.

stage_durations.title: Stage Durations
stage_durations.description: Seconds spent in each stage that has ended.

JobStatusResponse.title: JobStatusResponse
JobStatusResponse.description: Response model for job status polling.

LaborSupplyDecileMetric.title: LaborSupplyDecileMetric
LaborSupplyDecileMetric.description: Income- and substitution-effect responses keyed by income decile number.

LaborSupplyDecileOutput.title: LaborSupplyDecileOutput
LaborSupplyDecileOutput.description:
Labor supply responses by income decile.

``average`` is the response per household and ``relative`` the response
relative to the decile's baseline earnings.

LaborSupplyHoursOutput.title: LaborSupplyHoursOutput
LaborSupplyHoursOutput.description:
Total weekly hours worked under the baseline and reform, and how they change.

``change`` is reform minus baseline, split into its income and substitution
effects.

LaborSupplyRelativeResponse.title: LaborSupplyRelativeResponse
LaborSupplyRelativeResponse.description: Income- and substitution-effect responses relative to baseline earnings.

LaborSupplyResponseOutput.title: LaborSupplyResponseOutput
LaborSupplyResponseOutput.description:
Behavioral labor supply response to the reform.

``income_lsr`` and ``substitution_lsr`` are the total earnings changes from
the income and substitution effects, and ``total_change`` is their sum.

LocalAreaBreakdownOutput.title: LocalAreaBreakdownOutput
LocalAreaBreakdownOutput.description:
Completed result of a UK local-area breakdown run.

A request with ``breakdown: "local_areas"`` returns this instead of a
``SingleYearMacroOutput``. The run covers the requested UK-wide or nation
region on the local-area dataset alone, and computes only the
constituency and local-authority impacts; every other figure comes from
the national run. ``kind`` is always ``local_areas``. ``dataset`` names the
local-area dataset, ``data_version`` its release revision, and
``model_version`` and ``policyengine_version`` the country model and the
policyengine.py release that computed it. Each list holds only its own
level's records. Areas whose income change disclosure control withholds
are left out of each list, so a list may be empty.

``constituency_withheld_codes`` and ``local_authority_withheld_codes``
hold, sorted, the ONS codes of that level's areas that the run estimated
but disclosure control did not publish, so a client can tell a withheld
area from an absent one. An area the run never estimated, such as one with
no households in the dataset, is in neither list. An empty list means
that no area of the level was withheld. Null means that the result does
not report them, as results from older executors do not.

LocalAuthorityImpactRecord.title: LocalAuthorityImpactRecord
LocalAuthorityImpactRecord.description:
Reform impact on household net income in one UK local authority.

Fields mean the same as in ``ConstituencyImpactRecord``.

dataset_sha256.title: Dataset Sha256
dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 the policyengine.py bundle records for the dataset named in `dataset` (its certified artifact's, or else its dataset entry's), as registered when this bundle's app was deployed. Absent for apps deployed before this field existed.

PolicyEngineBundle.title: PolicyEngineBundle
PolicyEngineBundle.description: Resolved runtime provenance returned by the gateway.

PolicyParameterChanges.title: PolicyParameterChanges
PolicyParameterChanges.description: Policy parameter names mapped to their dated values.

PovertyByGenderOutput.title: PovertyByGenderOutput
PovertyByGenderOutput.description: Poverty and deep poverty rates by gender, as defined for ``PovertyOutput``.

PovertyByRaceOutput.title: PovertyByRaceOutput
PovertyByRaceOutput.description: US poverty rates by race and ethnicity; there is no deep poverty breakdown.

PovertyOutput.title: PovertyOutput
PovertyOutput.description:
Poverty and deep poverty rates by age group.

In the US these are the SPM poverty and deep SPM poverty rates. In the UK,
``poverty`` is relative and ``deep_poverty`` absolute poverty, both measured
before housing costs.

RacePovertyOutput.title: RacePovertyOutput
RacePovertyOutput.description: Baseline and reform poverty rates by race and ethnicity (US only).

SPMCapability.title: SPMCapability
SPMCapability.description:
Canonical SPM support offered by a simulation version.

``defaults`` is the pinned SPM selection, including the forecast artifact
hash and scenario, that applies to any option a request leaves out.

SPMComparisonProvenance.title: SPMComparisonProvenance
SPMComparisonProvenance.description: Compact receipts for the baseline and reform execution sets.

SPMErrorDetail.title: SPMErrorDetail
SPMErrorDetail.description:
A typed SPM input error.

``code`` is one of a fixed set of stable values, such as
``SPM_GEOGRAPHY_REQUIRED``, that clients can branch on; ``message`` explains
the problem to a person.

SPMExecutionProvenance.title: SPMExecutionProvenance
SPMExecutionProvenance.description: One shared receipt and the number of executions that produced it.

SPMProvenance.title: SPMProvenance
SPMProvenance.description: Compact detached receipt for one SPM calculation configuration.

SPMRuntimeVersions.title: SPMRuntimeVersions
SPMRuntimeVersions.description: Package versions required to reproduce one certified SPM execution.

SPMSelection.title: SPMSelection
SPMSelection.description:
Select from the bundle's pinned artifact; national geography is explicit.

County mode reads the household's observed ``county_fips``. A state alone
does not identify an SPM area. These settings contain no provider or path.

SimulationRequest.title: SimulationRequest
SimulationRequest.description:
Request model for simulation submission.

``breakdown: "local_areas"`` asks a UK-wide or nation run for its
constituency and local-authority impacts alone, computed on the
local-area dataset; the job's result is then a
``LocalAreaBreakdownOutput``. Without it, the job runs the usual
comparison.

SingleYearMacroOutput.title: SingleYearMacroOutput
SingleYearMacroOutput.description: Completed response returned by a single-year macro simulation.

TelemetryEnvelope.title: TelemetryEnvelope
TelemetryEnvelope.description: Bounded internal metadata passed from API request to Modal worker.

VersionMap.title: VersionMap
VersionMap.description: Version alias or exact version mapped to a deployed worker app.

spm_capabilities.title: Spm Capabilities
spm_capabilities.description: Canonical SPM capabilities keyed by exact PolicyEngine wrapper version. Resolve a country-model route to its app in the routing maps, then find that app's exact version in the policyengine map. App names, country-model versions and latest aliases are not capability keys.

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.description: Deployed bundle identity keyed by exact PolicyEngine wrapper version, then country: model and data versions, the default dataset and the SHA-256 the bundle records for it (the certified artifact's, or the dataset entry's). `policyengine.latest` is a wrapper version: read its identity at `bundles[latest]`.

VersionsResponse.title: VersionsResponse
VersionsResponse.description: All supported simulation routing version maps.
